subject: angol
title: Living together or living alone
instructionsHu: Nézd meg a két kép leírását. Írd le és hasonlítsd össze a képeket, fejtsd ki a véleményedet a megadott szempontok alapján, majd beszélgess a vizsgáztatóval a generációk együttéléséről és az önálló életről.

scenes.description: Three generations share a large house in a suburb. In the busy kitchen, a grandmother is teaching her ten-year-old granddaughter how to stretch strudel dough, while the father is answering work emails on a laptop at the end of the table. A teenage boy is coming in with bags of groceries. It is crowded and a bit chaotic, but the atmosphere is warm and lively.

A young man in his early twenties is sitting on the floor of a tiny rented studio flat in a big city. Cardboard boxes are still waiting to be unpacked, and he is eating instant noodles straight from the pot. He is video-calling his mother and showing her the view from his only window. He looks proud but a little lonely.

prompts: Compare the two living situations and what they might mean for the people in them.
What are the benefits and drawbacks of several generations living under one roof?
What makes it difficult for young people today to become independent?
followUpQuestions: Why do more and more young adults in Hungary live with their parents until their late twenties?
What can grandparents and grandchildren learn from each other?
Should the state help young people to buy or rent their first home? How?
How do you think family life will change in the next few decades?

usefulPhrases.en: He seems to be struggling with ...

usefulPhrases.hu: Ennek előnyei és hátrányai is vannak.

usefulPhrases.en: stand on your own two feet
Whereas the first picture shows ..., the second ...
usefulPhrases.hu: Míg az első kép ...-t mutatja, a második ...

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text:
Both pictures are about living situations, but they show two very different stages of life. In the first one, three generations are sharing a large house. In the busy kitchen, a grandmother is teaching her granddaughter how to stretch strudel dough, the father is answering work emails, and a teenage boy is coming in with the shopping. It's crowded and a bit chaotic, but the atmosphere looks warm. The second picture shows a young man in a tiny rented studio flat in a big city. He's surrounded by unpacked boxes, eating instant noodles straight from the pot, and video-calling his mother.
The family in the first picture have company and support, but probably not much privacy, while the young man has his freedom but seems a bit lonely. Living with several generations has real benefits: grandparents can help with the children and pass on traditions like making strudel. However, it can also lead to conflicts. As for independence, I think the main obstacle for young people today is money – rents have gone up so much that a studio flat can cost most of a starting salary.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Why do more and more young adults in Hungary live with their parents until their late twenties?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Mainly because of housing costs, as I said, but also because people study for longer. My cousin is twenty-seven and still lives at home because he's saving up for a deposit on a flat. Honestly, I can understand him.

notes: Összefüggő témakifejtés: a vizsgázó mindkét élethelyzetet leírja, mérlegeli előnyeiket és hátrányaikat (társaság és támogatás kontra szabadság és magány), kitér a többgenerációs együttélésre és a fiatalok önállósodásának akadályaira, a visszakérdezésnél pedig családi példát hoz.
Szókincs: pontos, témához illő szavak (three generations, studio flat, privacy, pass on traditions, a deposit on a flat, starting salary) és jó kötőszavak (while, However, As for).

Nyelvhelyesség: változatos B2-es szerkezetek hiba nélkül – Present Continuous a leírásban, 'while' ellentét, Present Perfect a 'so much that' következményes mondatban (rents have gone up so much that …) és 'because he's saving up for'.
Érdemes megtanulni: „two very different stages of life”, „pass on traditions”, „the main obstacle for young people today”, „a deposit on a flat”.
